# ramabana

> rama's arrow. a harness that does not miss

## Modules

- [ramabana.coding_patterns](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/coding_patterns.html.md): Answer.AI coding standards adapted to Ramabana's tools and nbdev workflow.
- [ramabana.debugging](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/debugging.html.md): Diagnose a failure, a misbehaving tool, or Ramabana itself.
- [ramabana.peer_work](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/peer_work.html.md): The rules an agent follows when it works for another session, or asks another session to work.
- [ramabana.racp](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/acp.html.md): Ramabana as an [Agent Client Protocol](https://agentclientprotocol.com/) agent: an editor drives this host through its own files and terminal.
- [ramabana.theory](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/theory.html.md): Naur's programming-as-theory-building, in the sense this team uses the word.
- [ramabana.vault](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/vault.html.md): Memory that outlives the process: a vishalakshi vault behind the host, and the watches that bring work back to the agent later.
- [ramabana.write_docs](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/write_docs.html.md): The voiceless register for the prose that ships with code, adapted from Answer.AI's write_docs.
- [ramabana.write_prose](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/write_prose.html.md): Anti-slop rules for narrative prose, adapted from Answer.AI's write_prose.
